title: FIRST-USER:327
text: - **Minimum activation:** for new or existing projects, reuse existing setup and guidance. Establish concise strategy, CURRENT-PLAN and relevant initiative docs, then hand off to steering to file meaningful work and route it through its workflow. Configure only what the first selected work requires; preserve existing checks, approvals and project rules. Activation succeeds when the first meaningful item reaches **done under its actual completion obligations**; merge alone is sufficient only when those obligations say so.
